item.tib: tshe dbang dz+wa this rigs lnga'i rgyas pa'i sbyin bsregs kyi mdel thung
item.coloph: de ltar dbang gi mdel thung nyung 'dus 'di/ bstan pa'i spar kha mtho phyir legs par sbyar/ rang 'dod g.yo zob can la gsang rgya sdom/ las ldan grub rigs tshogs la bka' 'di gtad/ thugs la gces gzung snyig (bzung snyigs) ma'i rtag (rtags) shar tshe/ brda' yig bris te zhang zhung gnas la sbos/ phyis nges med skyes bu gshed bzhi los/ zab mo gter gyis dbang skal rnyed par shog gter srung tshogs kyis ma g.yel bya ra gzob(gzobs//) phyis su bdag 'dra sems dpal ming brlam (rlom) gshen sprul pas/ gnas mchog phug leb ri khrod kyi g.yon zur tsi rta 'dra ba'i brag nas rnyed ste (de/)lo mang bka' rgya gdam (bsdams/) slar smra seng rnam rol smon sras pas bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang / hor sras 'jigs med rol pa'i rdo rje'am pu ni d+hadza yi/ thugs bzhed dang las ldan grwa ye tshul g.yu 'od rgyal brten (bstan) las dbang ngag dbang sogs kyi (kyis) bskul ba'i ngo skal du/ shog ser brda' ris bod yig du (tu) phab kyang*/ nyon mong dbang gi (gis) nor 'khrul ci mchis pa/ mkhyen ldan dam pa'i drung du bshags/ dge tshogs ci mchis ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'khod par shog/
